detail.longDescription: Court Upholds DOD Designation of Anthropic as Supply-Chain Risk A federal appellate court has upheld the Pentagon's designation of Anthropic as a supply-chain risk, allowing the Defense Department to ban its products from being used for official business. This decision comes after a panel of judges reviewed the case and ruled in favor of the Pentagon's designation. https:// osintsights.com/court-upholds- dod-designation-of-anthropic-as-supply-chain-risk?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=social # SupplyChainRisk # DepartmentOfDefense # EmergingThreats # ArtificialIntelligence # GovernmentRegulations
